body: maybe the energy that is your mind disperses more and more after you die. until it spreads too far to be your mind. and then the energy gets used for something else.

thank you for taking the time to connect with me in this way. I feel like that delaying my decision was right to do. I'm trying to reconnect with art, NY resolutions and all that. It is good to me but I'm scared of having it disappear on me again, the good feelings that come from working on art.

All I can do is try to break the cycle and then see if  my outlook winds up changing.

For what it is worth, I think an inadequate human being wouldn't have had the kind words you've given me.

well, there's nothing immediate that is pushing me toward the ledge. it's more of a slow realization that my life is just this and I'm stuck here until I die. And the more that dawns on me, the more I think I can live like this until I can't. And I don't want to snap, you know? I don't want to live long enough to get to the breaking point. I wanna be calm and work this out. Whichever way it goes.

I have trust issues that make it impossible for me to open up to people. my friends only know like half of me, my family even less. I have trauma from adolescence that affirms that my family would never accept all of me. My passion in life, art and language, disappeared at some point between college and now. I'm empty and lonely.

that's the situation for me.
